metadata.question: Were the water levels in Lake Kariba in December, 2019 higher than the water levels seen in December, 2018?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-1 GRD (COPERNICUS/S1_GRD) over a bounding polygon around Lake Kariba, comparing December 2018 vs December 2019. Sentinel-1 is all-weather and available monthly. If, unexpectedly, no images are found, fallback to JRC Monthly History.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed for Sentinel-1. Compute median VV backscatter per month and classify water with a conservative threshold VV < -17 dB.
3. Valid zero vs null: Check collection sizes first (C1). Then check valid pixel count of the median image (C2). After area calculation, verify values are finite (C3). A/B determined by whether 2019 water area > 2018 water area.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const aoi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [27.0, -16.1],
    [29.8, -16.1],
    [29.8, -18.7],
    [27.0, -18.7],
    [27.0, -16.1]
  ]);
  const dec2018 = {start: '2018-12-01', end: '2019-01-01', label: 'Dec 2018'};
  const dec2019 = {start: '2019-12-01', end: '2020-01-01', label: 'Dec 2019'};
  const scale = 1000; // per instructions (>=1000)
  const maxPixels = 1e9;
  const vvThresh = -17; // dB threshold for water

  async function getMetrics(period) {
    // Sentinel-1 collection
    let s1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD')
      .filterBounds(aoi)
      .filterDate(period.start, period.end)
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV'))
      .select(['VV']);
    let size = await s1.size().getInfo();
    let used = 'S1';
    // Fallback if empty
    if (!size || size === 0) {
      // Try JRC monthly history as fallback (waterClass band)
      const jrc = ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory')
        .filterBounds(aoi)
        .filterDate(period.start, period.end);
      const jrcSize = await jrc.size().getInfo();
      if (!jrcSize || jrcSize === 0) {
        return {status: 'C1', msg: `${period.label} Collections empty (S1 & JRC)`};
      }
      // Convert JRC waterClass==2 to water, compute area and valid px
      const jrcImg = ee.Image(jrc.first()).select('waterClass');
      const validCount = await jrcImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: aoi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('waterClass').getInfo();
      if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
        return {status: 'C2', msg: `${period.label} JRC has 0 valid pixels`};
      }
      const waterMask = jrcImg.eq(2).selfMask();
      const waterArea = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(waterMask).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: aoi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('area').getInfo();
      const presentArea = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(jrcImg.mask()).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: aoi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('area').getInfo();
      const waterKm2 = waterArea ? (waterArea / 1e6) : 0;
      const pct = (presentArea && presentArea > 0) ? (100 * waterArea / presentArea) : null;
      if (!isFinite(waterKm2) || pct === null || !isFinite(pct)) {
        return {status: 'C3', msg: `${period.label} JRC calc invalid`};
      }
      return {
        status: 'OK',
        used: 'JRC',
        imgs: jrcSize,
        validPx: validCount,
        waterKm2: waterKm2,
        pctWater: pct
      };
    }

    // Use Sentinel-1 median VV
    const vvMedian = s1.median();
    const validCount = await vvMedian.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('VV').getInfo();
    if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
      return {status: 'C2', msg: `${period.label} S1 has 0 valid pixels`};
    }
    const waterMask = vvMedian.lt(vvThresh);
    const waterArea = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(waterMask).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('area').getInfo();
    const presentArea = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(vvMedian.mask()).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('area').getInfo();
    const waterKm2 = waterArea ? (waterArea / 1e6) : 0;
    const pct = (presentArea && presentArea > 0) ? (100 * waterArea / presentArea) : null;
    if (!isFinite(waterKm2) || pct === null || !isFinite(pct)) {
      return {status: 'C3', msg: `${period.label} S1 calc invalid`};
    }
    return {
      status: 'OK',
      used: used,
      imgs: size,
      validPx: validCount,
      waterKm2: waterKm2,
      pctWater: pct
    };
  }

  // AOI area for context
  const aoiAreaKm2 = await ee.Image.pixelArea().clip(aoi).reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry: aoi,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: maxPixels
  }).get('area').getInfo().then(v => v / 1e6);

  const m2018 = await getMetrics(dec2018);
  const m2019 = await getMetrics(dec2019);

  // Handle failure cases
  if (m2018.status !== 'OK') {
    console.log(`${dec2018.label}: ${m2018.msg}`);
    console.log(`${dec2019.label}: ${m2019.status === 'OK' ? `${m2019.used} imgs:${m2019.imgs}, Valid px:${m2019.validPx}, Water km2:${m2019.waterKm2.toFixed(1)}, Water%:${m2019.pctWater.toFixed(1)}` : m2019.msg}`);
    if (m2018.status === 'C1') { console.log('C1'); return; }
    if (m2018.status === 'C2') { console.log('C2'); return; }
    console.log('C3'); return;
  }
  if (m2019.status !== 'OK') {
    console.log(`${dec2018.label}: ${m2018.used} imgs:${m2018.imgs}, Valid px:${m2018.validPx}, Water km2:${m2018.waterKm2.toFixed(1)}, Water%:${m2018.pctWater.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`${dec2019.label}: ${m2019.msg}`);
    if (m2019.status === 'C1') { console.log('C1'); return; }
    if (m2019.status === 'C2') { console.log('C2'); return; }
    console.log('C3'); return;
  }

  // 5. Validation & Final Answer
  console.log(`AOI area km2: ${aoiAreaKm2.toFixed(1)}, Scale: ${scale}m, Water threshold: VV < ${vvThresh} dB`);
  console.log(`${dec2018.label} — ${m2018.used} imgs:${m2018.imgs}, Valid px:${m2018.validPx}, Water km2:${m2018.waterKm2.toFixed(1)}, Water%:${m2018.pctWater.toFixed(1)}`);
  console.log(`${dec2019.label} — ${m2019.used} imgs:${m2019.imgs}, Valid px:${m2019.validPx}, Water km2:${m2019.waterKm2.toFixed(1)}, Water%:${m2019.pctWater.toFixed(1)}`);
  const delta = m2019.waterKm2 - m2018.waterKm2;
  console.log(`Δ Water km2 (2019-2018): ${delta.toFixed(1)}`);

  if (!isFinite(delta)) {
    console.log('C3');
  } else if (delta > 0) {
    console.log('A');
  } else {
    console.log('B');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
